# dv_ready manifest

## Files covered
- BTCUSD_1m_Binance_with_DV
- BTCUSD_1m_Bitfinex_with_DV
- BTCUSD_1m_BitMEX_with_DV
- BTCUSD_1m_Bitstamp_with_DV
- BTCUSD_1m_Coinbase_with_DV
- BTCUSD_1m_KuCoin_with_DV
- BTCUSD_1m_OKX_with_DV

## Original path
D:\click here\2代目\dv_ready

## Description
This folder contains the full exchange-level minute data with dollar-volume (DV) variables constructed for the BTCUSD market. These files are intermediate research objects used to build the synchronized aggregation and concentration panels.

## Time range
Full available sample used in the local workflow prior to the 2021–2022 paper sample restriction.

## Key variables
Typical exchange-level fields include:
- time_utc / minute timestamp
- exchange identifier
- venue-level BTCUSD price
- raw volume
- derived dollar-volume measure (DV)
- scaling-related fields where applicable

## Generated by
- make_dv_2021_2022.py and related local preprocessing workflow
- volume and coverage checking scripts in `src/build/`

## Used in paper
These files are upstream inputs for the synchronized exchange-level data construction. They are not cited directly in the main text, but they support the construction of aggregated prices and concentration measures used throughout the paper. 

## File status
These files are not included in the GitHub repository because they are large intermediate data objects.

## Actual storage location
Currently stored locally.

## Notes
Users who wish to reproduce the full pipeline should begin from the exchange-level minute data and then run the build scripts in the repository to reconstruct downstream files.
